definitions.explanation: The day before today. One of the most basic time expressions in Japanese.

examples.japanese: {昨日|きのう}は{何|なに}をしましたか。
{昨日|きのう}の{天気|てんき}はよかったです。
{昨日|きのう}{映画|えいが}を{見|み}ました。
{昨日|きのう}は{友達|ともだち}と{一緒|いっしょ}に{買|か}い{物|もの}に{行|い}きました。
examples.english: Yesterday I went shopping with my friend.

examples.japanese: {昨日|きのう}の{夜|よる}は{疲|つか}れていたので、{早|はや}く{寝|ね}ました。
examples.english: I was tired last night, so I went to bed early.

notes:
{昨日|きのう} means 'yesterday' and is one of the most basic time expressions in Japanese.

TIME SEQUENCE:
- おととい: day before yesterday
- {昨日|きのう}: yesterday
- {今日|きょう}: today
- {明日|あした}: tomorrow
- あさって: day after tomorrow

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {昨日|きのう}の{夜|よる}/{昨夜|さくや}: last night
- {昨日|きのう}の{朝|あさ}: yesterday morning
- {昨日|きのう}から: since yesterday

USAGE:
Like other time nouns, {昨日|きのう} often appears without a particle: {昨日|きのう}{買|か}いました (I bought it yesterday).

ALTERNATIVE READING:
{昨日|さくじつ} is a more formal reading used in news and writing.
